_description: REFUSAL/DISCONTINUATION OF HEMODIALYSIS SESSION/S scenario — form payload for tests/discontinuation.spec.ts. Filled into the Discontinue Of Hemodialysis form (load/visit-form/{visitId}/dis-of-hemodialysis, opened from the visit edit page's 'Discontinue Of Hemodialysis' tab) of the target visit (visitId from config/config.json → visitId). Static values are chosen from the real option lists on staging (relationship selects, checkbox ids); 'DYNAMIC' fields get fresh values per run. The form is bilingual — EN (*_en) and AR (*_ar) sides are both filled because the save() handler persists both. The visit ID itself is NOT here — it lives in config/config.json so all tests share one value.

_config._comment: No extra test parameters — the scenario is the form payload only.
